commands.label: Bootstrap Project
commands.summary: Seeds the canonical project, scene, preview, and publish session state.

commands.label: Switch Workspace
commands.summary: Moves the operator into a different workspace mode and marks downstream inspectors for refresh.

commands.label: Activate Tool
commands.summary: Changes the active authoring tool and updates the live tool preset context.

commands.label: Set Selection
commands.summary: Replaces the live entity selection and updates inspector read models.

commands.label: Frame Selection
commands.summary: Repositions the active camera around the current selection without mutating resources.

commands.label: Apply Brush
commands.summary: Applies a sculpt stroke, invalidates preview/topology state, and schedules the brush intent lane.

commands.label: Rebake Preview
commands.summary: Refreshes the GPU preview resources for the current session state.

commands.label: Refresh Topology
commands.summary: Runs the topology report intent against the current mesh resources.

commands.label: Refresh Publish Summary
commands.summary: Recomputes the publish summary artifact from the latest reports and resources.
